name: Fey Touched
benefit: +1 Wisdom (inherent). Grants misty step and charm person, each usable 1/day, outside the normal spell slot economy.
note: Not from a 3.5e sourcebook — the DM ported this 5e feat into the campaign, so there's no page citation. Future follow-ons per CLAUDE.md: character level 9 grants otherworldly magic (an arcane cantrip), level 15 grants Otherworldly Acumen (2nd-level arcane).
